context.transcript:
I hope you're enjoying this workshop for children's book authors.
In this next part of the workshop, we'll look at how to create characters that are memorable.
One way to capture children's attention is to give a character a special feature.
Here's a poster for the book series Barb and Friends.
One of the characters always wears a hat.
He wears a different hat on every page.
Even though he's not the main character, he's the most popular.
There are several children's books on the table at the back of the room.
Please spend about 10 minutes looking through the books on display.
Try to identify the features that make each character unique.
context.transcript_translation:
我希望你喜欢这个儿童书籍作者的研讨会。
在本次研讨会的下一部分，我们将研究如何创造令人难忘的角色。
吸引孩子注意力的一个方法是给角色赋予一个特殊的特征。
这是关于书系列《Barb and Friends》的海报。
其中一个角色总是戴着帽子。
他在每一页上都戴着不同的帽子。
尽管他不是主角，但他是最受欢迎的。
桌子后面摆放着几本儿童书籍。
请花大约10分钟浏览展示的书籍。
试着找出使每个角色独特的特征。
